summary: Pony AI Inc. filed a Form 6-K submitting a monthly return to The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited regarding movements in its authorized and issued share capital for May 2026. The filing reports no changes in authorized shares (600M total) or issued shares (352.5M Class A, 81.1M Class B) versus the prior month, and confirms compliance with public float requirements. This is a routine regulatory filing with no actionable deal terms.
